title: Revolut Metal Credit Card: 1pt Per $1 Spent, No Foreign Transaction Fee, Travel Insurance, $28.99 Monthly Fee @ Revolut
body:
Deal: Revolut Metal Credit Card: 1pt Per $1 Spent, No Foreign Transaction Fee, Travel Insurance, $28.99 Monthly Fee @ Revolut

[ashumz] Now that most FF cards offer (profanity) all now, this is looking atttractive.
[askbargain] There's no way these earn rates are sustainable long-term.
[mrhorse] Financial Times and Tinder
An interesting combo
[88mph] I know right… I'm more of a Herald Sun and OnlyFans sort of guy.
[adrianhughes1998] No points bonuses on sign-up though, but if you're spending shitloads a month it could be better as OP says than Amex for flexible rewards program
[nightelves] Those earn rates are is so good especially for Avios.
[isthisreallife22] If they offer me a fee free year I'll consider it
[Trance N Dance] Do you earn points on partial dollar amounts or only on whole dollars like Amex eg. Spend $20.54 and earn 20.54 points and they'll tally it all up and round it at the end of the statement when it credits or you'll only get 20 points and it's credited instantly.
[BatmanAU] Does it go against your credit rating when you apply?
[lolcoaster] "Earn 1 RevPoint per $3 of eligible spend - Not 1 point per $1" that's for the debit card. OP is referring to the credit card.
[PeppaCat] Yeah, looks like their website is not updated. Find the information in the app
[dsesaz] Where did you find the statement on "40% off Foreign Transaction Fee"? I can only see "40% off International transfer fees discount", which means sending money abroad, not paying in foreign currency with your cards.
[hambogan] The 40% off fee is referring to the fee when you transfer your account balance to overseas account, not for credit card purchases.
